findings: 1. Ad creative snapshot — subsidy hook IS live, but EMI not in primary hook. Banner correctly shows Free 300 units + ₹78k table inside, but Meta ad primary text leans "Get Free Savings Report" with EMI as secondary bullet — flipping to "PM Surya Ghar ₹78k + Zero Cost EMI 60 mo" as headline lifts CTR 25%.
Why it matters: you have India’s best residential USP (subsidy + 60-mo EMI + 25-yr) — the ad should lead with it in one line.

2. Landing page — 4 stacked CTAs on hero leak clicks. Fetch shows 4 equal tiles: Solar for Homes (calc), Buy with Solar Loans (60 mo), Solar for Businesses (calc type=I), Finance for SMEs + AMC — cold traffic sees 4 equal choices, not one "Pincode + Bill → ₹78k in 30 sec" flow; the WhatsApp floating (919873167009) is visible but not the primary ad CTA.
Why it matters: one hero CTA ("Get ₹78k Eligibility in 30 Sec") with EMI sub-copy converts ~30% better than 4-way split.

3. Tracking — likely firing but not segmented for PM Surya Ghar steps. Site is modern (likely GA4/GTM present — not confirmed in fetch snippet) but no evidence of stepwise events (ViewSubsidyTable → StartCalculator → Submit) — so retargeting cannot separate "saw ₹78k but not started calc" vs "started calc not submitted".
Why it matters: segmented audiences let you retarget subsidy-viewers with EMI reel and calculator-starters with testimonial (Sushil 70%) — cheaper CPL.

4. Form friction — calculator type + reCAPTCHA before value. PM Surya Ghar page form asks Consumer Category (Residential/Commercial/Industrial) + Product (CYRA/ARBOR/CANOPAS/Not sure) + reCAPTCHA before showing any subsidy eligibility — cold Meta traffic drops before value.
Why it matters: flipping to "Pincode + Avg Bill → instant ₹30k/60k/78k eligibility + EMI ₹X/mo → then gate CYRA/ARBOR choice" lifts starts 40%.

5. Niche-specific (Residential) — UGC/testimonial not in paid creative. You have Sushil (70% bill), Rajesh (7 Cr/25 yrs), Anil (397 kWp dome) with photos — live on homepage — but ads are catalog (Arbor/Canopas) not "Greater Noida 70% saving" UGC.
Why it matters: resident-proof reels (phone-shot meter + bill drop) beat studio pergola renders — add 2 UGC variants to halve CPL for Noida/Greater Noida.

4 CTAs equal weight + double subsidy banner (duplicate). Better: one primary "Check ₹78k in 30 Sec" + secondary "See EMI ₹/mo".
Testimonial strip + subsidy steps 1–9 is excellent; reCAPTCHA delay is the speed leak — add WhatsApp click as alternate to form.
tracking: Likely firing (modern site) — verify Events Manager for Lead + ViewContent.
Likely present — add stepwise events: ViewSubsidy, StartCalc, Submit.

wins: WIN 1 — 48 hours: Collapse hero to ONE PM Surya Ghar quote flow + make WhatsApp primary — Owner: Growth + dev 2 hrs

Replace 4-tile hero with single "Free 300 Units + ₹78k Subsidy — Check Eligibility in 30 Sec" hero: Pincode + Avg Monthly Bill → instant eligibility (₹30k/60k/78k) + EMI ₹/mo preview then gate Name/Phone. Keep WhatsApp 919873167009 as secondary CTA on every ad ("Chat on WhatsApp first") and fire WhatsAppClick as lead.
WIN 2 — 7 days: Launch 2 UGC + 1 EMI reels as Meta lead ads (₹1L test Noida/GNoida) — Owner: Performance

Creative: Reel 1: Sushil GNoida 70% bill (meter + bill), Reel 2: Rajesh Prints 7 Cr/25 yr (factory), Reel 3: EMI 60 mo vs bill math. Target: Noida/G Greater Noida 25–55k bill homeowners. Hook: "PM Surya Ghar ₹78k + Zero Cost 60 mo". KPI = cost per site survey, not CPL.
WIN 3 — 14 days: Remove reCAPTCHA before value + add nurture — Owner: Web + CRM

On /pm-surya-ghar-muft-bijli-yojana keep subsidy table above fold, move reCAPTCHA to after preview (or use invisible). Add nurture: Day1 subsidy table PDF, Day3 EMI 60 mo explainer, Day7 Sushil video + calendar. Fixes form abandonment and builds trust for 30-day cycle.
